def factor_volume_price_beta_logvol_liquidity_adj(df):
    """Volume-price coupling beta with log volume change and Amihud liquidity attenuation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret_1 = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    log_vol = np.log(df_copy["volume"].replace(0.0, np.nan))
    vol_chg = log_vol.diff()
    cov = ret_1.rolling(20, min_periods=5).cov(vol_chg)
    var = vol_chg.rolling(20, min_periods=5).var()
    beta = cov / var.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    beta = beta.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    dollar_volume = df_copy["volume"] * df_copy["close"]
    illiquidity = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / dollar_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    avg_illiquidity = illiquidity.rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + avg_illiquidity)
    factor = beta * weight
    df_copy["factor_volume_price_beta_logvol_liquidity_adj"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_price_beta_logvol_liquidity_adj"]
